correctness.rationale: For all n>=3, equality of the 011 and 110 multiplicities plus fixed number of zeros yields the primitive kernel (1,-3,3,-1). The exact 001 count difference is s(z-y+3s); only s=0 or s=(y-z)/3 survives. The 100 difference is identical; all other pattern counts follow from the linear invariants and total count, proving the converse. Nonnegative integer solutions admit a unique x,z,v,d parametrization and give the exact rational pair GF. Boundary n<3 and single classes are accounted for; finite code checks independently reconstruct all short decks.
